_comment: OBSERVED SPECIMEN — not constructed. Do not 'tidy' this file.
Google Meet transcript, saved to Drive as a Google Doc named
'<title> - <YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM TZ> - Notes by Gemini' and downloaded as .docx
(the default). The Doc has TWO tabs, 'Notes' (Gemini's AI summary) and
'Transcript'; the .docx export FLATTENS BOTH into one paragraph stream.
python-docx sees exactly these 19 paragraphs, of which ONE is speech.
Why this file exists: docs/design-cloud-import.md records two separate
six-month bugs (Swift's TeamsRecordingName, and _TEAMS_SUFFIX_RE in
s01_ingest.py) caused by regexes pinned to a fixture invented alongside
them. A format grammar must be pinned by an observed specimen.
TWO DELIBERATE DEPARTURES from the captured bytes, both recorded here so
this is not mistaken for a verbatim dump:
1. The attendee email in paragraph 3 was the capturing user's real
personal address. Replaced with an RFC 2606 reserved address — this
repo is public. The invariant under test is that an 'Invited <email>
<Name>' paragraph never reaches the transcript corpus; the specific
address is not the invariant.
2. Paragraphs 7, 11 and 16 were elided with '...' in the first capture

report and have since been completed from the source .docx. Note
     that paragraph 16 is the SPEECH paragraph — while truncated, the
     assertions about it were checking a prefix of the real thing.
This specimen UNDERSTATES the problem: Gemini declined to summarise (too
little speech), so paragraphs 7 and 9 are stubs. On a real 60-minute
interview those are paragraphs of confident AI prose about what the
participants said — which the pre-fix parser ingested as quotable speech.
